questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wadanne haruffa uku ne ake kira 'haruffan ajiye murya' (glottalized/hooked letters) a rubutun Hausa na boko?
questions.explanation: Ɓ, Ɗ and Ƙ are the glottalized (hooked) consonants of Hausa, distinct in both sound and spelling from their plain counterparts B, D and K.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira harafin da ake amfani da shi domin nuna dogon wasali a wasu rubuce-rubucen Hausa, ta hanyar maimaita wasalin?
questions.explanation: Vowel length in Hausa is sometimes indicated in writing by doubling the vowel letter, showing that the sound is held longer than a short vowel.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A ka'idojin rubutun Hausa, me ya kamata a yi da sunan mutum ko wuri a farkon rubutu?
options: A sanya alamar tambaya bayansa koyaushe
A rubuta shi duka da karamin baki
A rubuta harafin farko da babban baki
questions.explanation: As with standard capitalization rules, proper nouns such as personal or place names begin with a capital letter in written Hausa.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace alama ce ake amfani da ita domin raba jerin abubuwa a cikin jimla, kamar 'Na sayi shinkafa, wake, da gyada'?
questions.explanation: The comma (waƙafi) is used to separate items in a list within a sentence, just as in standard English usage.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira rubuta kalma ba daidai ba saboda rashin sanin inda ake amfani da ƙ maimakon k?
questions.explanation: Confusing letters such as ƙ and k, which represent different sounds in Hausa, produces a spelling error that can change or obscure a word's meaning.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A rubutun Hausa, wace alama ake amfani da ita domin nuna mamaki ko fadin murya, kamar 'Kash!'?
questions.explanation: The exclamation mark (alamar mamaki) is placed after an interjection or exclamatory statement to convey surprise or strong emotion.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Idan aka rubuta 'ɗan'uwa' da alamar sirara a tsakani, me alamar take nunawa a can?
options: Cewa an rage wani sauti ko an hada gajerun kalmomi biyu
Cewa kalmar aro ce daga Turanci
questions.explanation: The apostrophe here marks a contraction, showing that sounds have been elided where two shorter elements have been joined into one word.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene babban bambanci tsakanin 'k' da 'ƙ' a rubutun Hausa?
options: Babu wani bambanci, ana amfani da su daidai wa daida
'K' ana amfani da shi kawai wajen rubuta lambobi
'Ƙ' baƙi ne mai ƙin murya (ejective) wanda ya sha bamban da 'k' na yau da kullum a furuci da ma'ana
'Ƙ' ana amfani da shi kawai a farkon jimla
questions.explanation: Ƙ represents an ejective consonant, phonetically and semantically distinct from plain k; swapping them can change a word's meaning entirely.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace ka'ida ce ta shafi amfani da 'babban baki' (capital letters) wajen fara sabuwar jimla a rubutun Hausa?
options: Ana fara kowace sabuwar jimla da babban baki
Ana fara kowace kalma da babban baki
Ana amfani da babban baki ne kawai a karshen jimla
Ba a taba amfani da babban baki a Hausa ba
questions.explanation: As in many written languages, each new sentence in Hausa conventionally begins with a capital letter.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A ka'idojin rubutu, me ya sa ake bukatar daidaiton rubuta kalmomin aro (loan words) kamar 'talifon' ko 'mota'?
options: Domin a mayar da su kalmomin Larabci
Domin a hana amfani da kalmomin aro gaba daya
Domin a guji sabani a rubutu tsakanin mabambantan marubuta
questions.explanation: Standardising the spelling of loan words helps maintain consistency across writers and texts, avoiding confusion from multiple competing spellings of the same borrowed word.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace alama ce ake amfani da ita a karshen jimla ta yau da kullum wadda ba ta tambaya ko mamaki ba?
questions.explanation: The full stop (aya) is the standard punctuation mark used to close an ordinary declarative sentence in written Hausa.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira amfani da baƙin sirri irin su 'ts' ko 'sh' a matsayin haruffa biyu da ke wakiltar sauti daya kacal a rubutun Hausa?
questions.explanation: Digraphs are combinations of two letters, such as 'ts' or 'sh', used together to represent a single distinct sound in Hausa orthography.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Idan tambayar fahimta ta ce 'me ya sa marubuci ya rubuta wannan sakin layi?', wace fasaha ake auna wa dalibi?
questions.explanation: Questions about why an author wrote a passage or included certain details test the student's ability to identify the author's purpose.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A jarabawar fahimtar rubutu, menene ake kira kalmomin da marubuci ke amfani da su domin nuna ra'ayinsa game da wani abu?
questions.explanation: An author's tone reflects their attitude toward the subject, conveyed through word choice, and is a common focus of comprehension questions.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Idan dalibi ya kasa fahimtar wata kalma a cikin labari, wace dabara ce ta fi taimakawa kafin ya duba ƙamus?
options: Ya duba yadda kalmar ta zo tare da sauran kalmomin da ke kewaye da ita
Ya sauya kalmar da wata a rubuce
Ya tsallake sauran labarin gaba daya
questions.explanation: Using surrounding context clues is generally the most efficient first strategy for inferring an unfamiliar word's meaning within a passage.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira kwatanta abu biyu ko fiye domin gano kamanceceniya ko banbanci a cikin wani labari?
questions.explanation: Comparison-and-contrast questions ask the reader to identify similarities and differences between two or more elements presented in a passage.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A cikin wani labari, idan marubuci ya bayyana dalilin da ya sa wani abu ya faru, wace alaka ake kira wannan?
questions.explanation: A cause-and-effect relationship explains why an event occurred (the cause) and what resulted from it (the effect), a common comprehension focus.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Idan tambaya ta ce 'wace magana ce mafi dacewa da ta zama taken (title) wannan labarin?', menene ake auna wa dalibi?
options: Iya fahimtar babban ra'ayin labarin gaba daya
questions.explanation: Choosing the best title for a passage tests whether the student has grasped its overall main idea rather than an isolated detail.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace fasaha ake kira iya bambance tsakanin gaskiya (fact) da ra'ayi (opinion) a cikin wani rubutu?
options: Bambance gaskiya da ra'ayi (fact vs. opinion)
questions.explanation: Distinguishing verifiable facts from the author's personal opinions is a key higher-order comprehension skill tested in reading passages.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Idan wani sashe na labari ya ce 'ta yi shiru na dogon lokaci, idanunta na cike da hawaye', me tambaya za ta iya bukata daga dalibi?
options: Ya yi hasashen yadda halin mutumin yake ji
questions.explanation: Descriptive details like silence and tears typically require the reader to infer the character's emotional state, an inference-based comprehension skill.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene mafi kyawun mataki na farko kafin amsa tambayoyin fahimtar rubutu masu tsayi?
options: Karanta duk labarin sosai domin fahimtar jigo gaba daya
Karanta tambayoyin ne kawai ba tare da labarin ba
questions.explanation: Reading the whole passage carefully first builds the overall understanding needed to answer both detail and inference questions accurately.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Idan tambaya ta bukaci a bayyana yadda wani hali (character) ya canza daga farkon labari zuwa karshensa, wace fasaha ake auna?
questions.explanation: Tracking how a character changes over the course of a passage tests the reader's grasp of character development, a higher-order comprehension skill.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira jerin bayanai na goyon baya wadanda marubuci ke bayarwa domin tabbatar da babban ra'ayinsa a cikin labari?
questions.explanation: Supporting details are the specific facts or examples an author provides to reinforce and substantiate the passage's main idea.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Nawa ne adadin wasulan Hausa na asali (basic vowels) da ake amfani da su a rubutu, kafin la'akari da tsayinsu?
questions.explanation: Standard Hausa recognises five basic vowel qualities — a, e, i, o, u — each of which can also occur long or short.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A Hausa, menene ake kira baƙin da ake furtawa ta hanyar hura iska tsakanin harshe da rufin baki, kamar 'sh'?
questions.explanation: Fricative consonants like 'sh' are produced by forcing air through a narrow channel, creating friction, unlike stop consonants which fully block airflow momentarily.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira baƙaƙen da ake furtawa da hanci, kamar 'm' da 'n'?
questions.explanation: Nasal consonants such as 'm' and 'n' are produced with airflow passing through the nasal cavity rather than solely through the mouth.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Idan wasali biyu daban-daban suka hadu su zama sauti daya a furuci, ana kiran wannan tsari
questions.explanation: When two adjacent vowels combine or glide together into a single perceived sound unit, this vowel-combination process is at work.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A tsarin sauti na Hausa, menene ake kira kawar da wani sauti daga furucin kalma domin sauƙaƙe magana?
questions.explanation: Elision is the omission of a sound during speech to ease pronunciation, a recognised phonological process across many languages including Hausa.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wanne daga cikin wadannan baƙaƙen guda uku ake kira 'implosive' a Hausa?
options: Ɓ, Ɗ, da wasu amfani na Y (ƴ)
questions.explanation: Ɓ and Ɗ are classic implosive consonants in Hausa, and ƴ marks a glottalized y, all involving a distinct airstream mechanism from plain consonants.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira kalmomi biyu da suke da sauti daya amma ma'ana daban-daban saboda bambancin karin sauti (tone) kawai?
options: Kalmomin da karin sauti ke bambanta ma'anarsu (tonal minimal pairs)
questions.explanation: In a tonal language like Hausa, otherwise identical word forms can carry entirely different meanings depending solely on their tone pattern.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A furucin Hausa, menene ake kira tsayin lokacin da ake ɗauka wajen furta wasali, wanda zai iya zama gajere ko dogo?
questions.explanation: Vowel length — whether a vowel is pronounced short or long — is phonemically significant in Hausa and can distinguish word meaning.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wanne fanni ne ke musamman nazarin mafi karancin sashin sauti da zai iya bambance ma'anar kalmomi biyu?
options: Fonoloji (phonology), musamman ta hanyar ma'aunin sauti (phoneme)
questions.explanation: Phonology studies phonemes — the smallest sound units capable of distinguishing meaning between words — as its central unit of analysis.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira baƙaƙen da ake furta su ta hanyar tsayar da iska gaba daya na wani lokaci sannan a saki, kamar 'b', 'd', 'k'?
questions.explanation: Plosive (stop) consonants such as 'b', 'd' and 'k' are produced by fully blocking airflow momentarily before releasing it abruptly.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A tsarin sauti na Hausa, menene ake kira wurin da ake samar da sauti a bakin magana, kamar leɓe ko hakori?
questions.explanation: Place of articulation refers to the specific point in the vocal tract, such as the lips or teeth, where a consonant sound is produced.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira kari da ake sawa a gaban tushen kalma domin canza ma'anarta, kamar 'maras-' a 'marasa lafiya'?
questions.explanation: A prefix is an affix attached to the beginning of a root word to modify or extend its meaning.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira kari da ake sawa a bayan tushen kalma, kamar '-ai' domin nuna jam'i a wasu kalmomi?
questions.explanation: A suffix is attached to the end of a root word, and Hausa commonly uses suffixation among other strategies to mark plurality.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Ta yaya ake samar da jam'i na kalmar 'mutum' a Hausa?
questions.explanation: 'Mutum' (person) has the irregular but widely known plural form 'mutane' (people).

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira kalmomin da aka hada su daga kalmomi biyu masu zaman kansu domin samar da sabuwar ma'ana, kamar 'gidan sarki'?
questions.explanation: Compound words combine two independently meaningful words into a single new lexical item with its own meaning, as with 'gidan sarki' (palace).

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira sashin nahawu wanda ke nuna aikatau (verb) ya faru a baya, yanzu, ko nan gaba?
questions.explanation: Tense marking indicates when an action expressed by a verb takes place — past, present, or future.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A ƙirar kalma, menene ake kira tsarin da ake maimaita wani bangare na kalma domin canza ma'ana ko nuna jam'i, kamar a wasu sunaye?
questions.explanation: Reduplication, repeating part or all of a word, is a morphological process found in Hausa used to derive new forms or plural senses.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wanne rukunin kalma ne ke nuna suna ko siffa domin bayyana adadin abu, kamar 'daya', 'biyu', 'uku'?
questions.explanation: Numerals are the word class used to express quantity or count, such as daya (one), biyu (two), uku (three).

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira kalmar da ake samu ta hanyar kara wa fi'ili wani kari domin nuna wanda ke yin aikin (mai suna daga fi'ili)?
questions.explanation: Derived nouns can be formed from verbs, often to name the doer or agent of an action, a common word-formation pattern in Hausa morphology.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wanne fanni ne ke musamman nazarin yadda ake gina kalmomi daga karin haruffa ko sassan ma'ana (morphemes)?
questions.explanation: Morphology is the study of how words are constructed from morphemes, the smallest units that carry grammatical or lexical meaning.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira mafi karancin sashin ma'ana a cikin kalma, wanda ba za a iya rarraba shi zuwa karami ba tare da ya rasa ma'ana ba?
questions.explanation: A morpheme is the smallest meaningful unit within a word; it cannot be further divided without losing its grammatical or lexical meaning.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A ƙirar kalma, menene ake kira kari da ake sawa a tsakiyar tushen kalma (ba a farko ko karshe ba)?
questions.explanation: An infix is an affix inserted within the root of a word, distinct from a prefix (front) or suffix (end).

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A gidajen kalmomi (syntax) na Hausa, wace tsari ce mafi common ta jimla mai sauki: fa'ili, fi'ili, sannan abin fi'ili?
questions.explanation: The basic Hausa sentence order is Subject-Verb-Object, similar to English, as in 'Musa ya sayi littafi' (Musa bought a book).

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira wanda ke aiwatar da aikin da fi'ili ke bayyanawa a cikin jimla, kamar 'Aisha' a 'Aisha ta dafa abinci'?
questions.explanation: The subject (fa'ili) is the doer of the verb's action in a sentence, here 'Aisha' who performs the cooking.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A cikin jimlar 'Bello ya karanta littafi', menene 'littafi' a matsayin sashin jimla?
questions.explanation: 'Littafi' (book) is the object of the sentence, being the thing that receives the action of reading.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira kalmar da ke nuna alaka tsakanin suna da wani sashin jimla, kamar 'a', 'cikin', 'kan'?
questions.explanation: Prepositions like 'a' (at/in), 'cikin' (inside) and 'kan' (on) express relationships between a noun and other parts of the sentence.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira kalmar da ke hada jimloli biyu ko fiye, kamar 'kuma', 'amma', 'ko'?
questions.explanation: Conjunctions such as 'kuma' (and), 'amma' (but) and 'ko' (or) join two or more clauses or phrases together.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A cikin jimla mai amsa, wace kalma ce ke maye gurbin suna domin gujewa maimaici, kamar 'shi', 'ita', 'su'?
questions.explanation: Pronouns like 'shi' (he/it), 'ita' (she/it) and 'su' (they) substitute for nouns to avoid repetition.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira jimlar da take dauke da fa'ili da fi'ili guda daya kacal, ba tare da wata karamar jimla a cikinta ba?
questions.explanation: A simple sentence contains a single subject and a single main verb, expressing one complete idea without subordinate clauses.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira jimla biyu masu zaman kansu da aka hada su da kalmar hadewa kamar 'kuma' ko 'amma'?
questions.explanation: A compound sentence joins two independent clauses, each capable of standing alone, using a coordinating conjunction such as 'kuma' or 'amma'.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A jimlar 'Domin ruwa ya sauka, mun kwana a gida', wace irin jimla ce wannan idan aka duba tsarin fannin nahawu?
options: Jimla mai dogaro (complex sentence, with a subordinate clause)
questions.explanation: This sentence contains a subordinate clause ('domin ruwa ya sauka') that depends on the main clause, making it a complex sentence.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wanne fanni ne ke musamman nazarin yadda ake tsara kalmomi domin samar da jimloli daidai bisa ka'idojin nahawu?
questions.explanation: Syntax is the branch of grammar concerned with how words combine to form well-formed phrases and sentences.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira kalmar da ke kwatanta suna, kamar 'baƙar', 'dogo', 'karami'?
questions.explanation: Adjectives such as 'baƙar' (black), 'dogo' (tall) and 'karami' (small) describe qualities of nouns.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira karin maganar hikima da al'umma ke amfani da ita domin isar da wani babban gaskiya a takaice, kamar 'Rowar kaza ba ta kai na zomo ba'?
questions.explanation: A karin magana is a short, traditional saying that conveys a broadly recognised piece of wisdom or truth in a memorable, figurative way.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene karin maganar 'Kowa ya ga rina, ba ya ganin fari' yake koyarwa?
options: Cewa mutane su guji sanya tufafi masu launi
Cewa fararen tufafi sun fi kowanne launi
Cewa launi na rina ba shi da amfani
Yadda kwarewa ko sabon abin da mutum yayi ke rufe masa idanu daga sauran zabuka
questions.explanation: This proverb figuratively teaches that once a person becomes accustomed to or preoccupied with one thing, they may overlook other equally valid options.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira gajeriyar magana ta wasa da take amfani da kwatance domin bunkasa hankalin masu sauraro, misali 'Ina take ta rawa amma babu kafa?'
questions.explanation: A kacici-kacici (riddle) is a short playful question or puzzle that challenges listeners to think figuratively, often used to sharpen wit.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira labarin gargajiya na baka wanda galibi ke dauke da dabbobi masu magana kuma ke koyar da darasi na ɗabi'a?
questions.explanation: Tatsuniya are traditional orally-transmitted folktales, often featuring talking animals, told chiefly to entertain while imparting moral lessons.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira kalaman yabo ko bayyana halayen wani mutum, dangi, ko dabba, wanda ake yi domin daukaka matsayinsa, kamar kirarin zaki?
questions.explanation: Kirari are traditional praise epithets recited to honour and elevate the status of a person, lineage, or even an animal, highlighting notable qualities.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira maganar da ake yi ta kwatanci ko a kaikaice domin zambatar wani ba tare da ambaton sunansa kai tsaye ba?
questions.explanation: Habaici is a form of indirect verbal expression used to criticise or mock someone without naming them directly, relying on the listener to infer the target.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A cikin adabin baka na Hausa, wace irin waka ce ake rerawa domin sauƙaƙe wa ma'aikata gajiya yayin aiki, kamar dambe ko noma?
questions.explanation: Work songs (waƙoƙin aiki) are traditionally sung to ease the tedium of communal labour such as farming or physical exertion, coordinating rhythm and effort.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene karin maganar 'Hakuri maganin duniya' ke koyarwa wa mai sauraro?
options: Cewa babu wani abu da zai warware matsala sai kudi
Cewa a guji yin aiki tukuru
Cewa jimiri da hakuri suna taimaka wa mutum wajen shawo kan matsalolin rayuwa
Cewa duniya ba ta da magani gaba daya
questions.explanation: This widely known proverb teaches that patience and perseverance are essential tools for overcoming life's difficulties.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira gajerun jimloli masu ma'ana zurfi da ake amfani da su domin gargadi ko koyar da hikima, wadanda suka bambanta da tatsuniya domin basu da doguwar labari?
questions.explanation: Proverbs are distinct from folktales in that they are short, fixed, wisdom-laden expressions rather than extended narratives.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A al'adar baka ta Hausa, wanene galibi ke da alhakin isar da tatsuniyoyi ga yara, musamman da dare?
questions.explanation: Storytelling of tatsuniyoyi, especially at night, has traditionally been carried out by grandparents, particularly grandmothers, as part of oral moral education.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira waƙoƙin da ake rerawa domin yabon jarumi ko sarki a bukukuwa, misali wajen shan ganga?
questions.explanation: Praise songs (waƙoƙin yabo) are performed at ceremonies to celebrate and honour notable figures such as chiefs or warriors, often accompanied by drumming.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene karin maganar 'Kome nisan jifa, kasa zai fadi' yake nunawa?
options: Cewa jifa wasa ne kawai na yara
Cewa kasa ba ta da wani amfani
Cewa duk yadda wani abu ya yi nisa ko girma, akwai iyaka ko ƙarshen da zai kai
Cewa dutse ba ya iya tashi
questions.explanation: This proverb conveys that no matter how far-reaching an action or ambition, it will eventually reach its natural limit or conclusion.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace fasaha ce ake amfani da ita a tatsuniyoyin Hausa domin ba dabbobi irin su Gizo (gizo-gizo) hali na dan Adam kamar magana da wayo?
questions.explanation: Personification, giving animals human traits such as speech and cunning (as with the trickster spider Gizo), is a common storytelling device in Hausa folktales.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira gajerun jimlolin roƙo ko addu'a da ake yi domin neman albarka kafin fara wani aiki, kamar noma ko tafiya?
questions.explanation: Short invocations or blessings are traditionally recited to seek favourable outcomes before undertaking activities such as farming or travel.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A cikin al'adar Hausa, menene ake kira gajerun kalmomin yabo da ake ambata kafin sunan wani sarki ko jarumi domin girmama shi, kamar 'Sarkin Fada'?
options: Kirari kawai ba tare da wata alaka ba
questions.explanation: A take is a title or honorific customarily placed before a chief's or dignitary's name as a mark of respect and recognition of status.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene karin maganar 'Gudun zomo, zuwan zomo' yake koyarwa?
options: Cewa duk inda mutum ya tafi ko ya guje, zai dawo kan hanyar sa ne, ko makomarsa ba ta canza ba
Cewa zomo ba shi da wani amfani
questions.explanation: This proverb suggests that a person's ultimate path or fate tends to bring them back to where they started or belong, regardless of how far they roam.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A adabin baka, menene manufar amfani da 'yan wasan kwaikwayo na gargajiya (traditional drama/masquerade performance) a bukukuwan al'umma?
options: Domin nishadantarwa da koyar da darussan zamantakewa ga al'umma
Domin siyar da kayan gargajiya kawai
questions.explanation: Traditional masquerade and dramatic performances at community festivals serve both to entertain and to reinforce social and moral lessons.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira rubuce-rubucen adabi na Hausa da aka fara buga su a rubuce bayan zuwan boko, sabanin adabin baka?
questions.explanation: Written literature (rubutaccen adabi) refers to Hausa literary works composed and preserved in writing, as distinct from the orally transmitted tradition.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A tarihin adabin Hausa, wane irin littafi ne 'Ruwan Bagaja' wanda Abubakar Imam ya rubuta?
questions.explanation: 'Ruwan Bagaja' by Abubakar Imam is a celebrated Hausa novel, one of the pioneering works of written Hausa fiction produced in the colonial era.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wanene marubucin da aka fi sani da rubuta littafin 'Magana Jari Ce', wani muhimmin tarin labarai na Hausa?
questions.explanation: Abubakar Imam authored 'Magana Jari Ce', a foundational multi-volume collection of moralistic tales in Hausa literature.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene babban salon adabi da aka fi amfani da shi domin isar da darussan ɗabi'a a cikin littattafan Abubakar Imam?
options: Amfani da labarun kwatanci masu koyar da hikima da ɗabi'a
questions.explanation: Imam's works are especially known for using illustrative, moralistic storytelling to impart wisdom and ethical lessons to readers.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wanene aka sani a matsayin marubucin littafin 'Shaihu Umar', wani muhimmin labari na farko-farkon rubutaccen adabin Hausa?
questions.explanation: 'Shaihu Umar' is a well-known early Hausa novel authored by Sir Abubakar Tafawa Balewa, who later became Nigeria's first Prime Minister.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A fannin adabi, menene ake kira rubutaccen aiki na adabi wanda aka tsara shi domin a yi shi a kan dandali a gaban jama'a?
questions.explanation: Drama (wasan kwaikwayo) is a written literary form specifically composed for live performance before an audience.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene babban fasalin waƙar Hausa ta gargajiya idan aka kwatanta da rubutacciyar waƙar zamani?
options: Ta gargajiya ta fi jaddada karin sauti da ma'auni na baka, yayin da ta zamani ke amfani da tsarin rubutu daban-daban
Waƙar gargajiya ba ta da jigo
Ba su da wani bambanci gaba daya
Waƙar zamani ba ta da marubuci
questions.explanation: Traditional Hausa poetry places strong emphasis on oral metre and tonal patterning, while modern written poetry has diversified in structural forms.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira babban jigo ko sako da marubucin rubutaccen labari yake so ya isar wa masu karatu?
questions.explanation: The theme (jigo) is the central message or underlying idea that a literary work seeks to communicate to its readers.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Ta yaya rubutaccen adabin Hausa ya samu bunkasuwa a lokacin mulkin mallaka, bisa ga tarihin adabi?
options: Ta hanyar rufe dukkan makarantun gargajiya
Ta hanyar gasar rubutun litattafai da hukumomin mulkin mallaka suka shirya, wadda ta samar da litattafai kamar 'Ruwan Bagaja'
questions.explanation: A notable colonial-era literary competition helped spur the emergence of early published Hausa novels, including 'Ruwan Bagaja'.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A rubutaccen adabin Hausa, menene ake kira mutumin da ke tafiyar da labari ko wasan kwaikwayo daga fara zuwa karshe, misali babban jarumi?
questions.explanation: The protagonist is the central character around whom the main action of a novel, play, or narrative revolves.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira babban bikin aure na gargajiya na Hausa da ake yi domin hada ma'aurata biyu bisa al'ada da addini?
questions.explanation: The traditional wedding ceremony (bikin aure) formally unites a couple according to Hausa customary and religious practice.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A al'adar Hausa, wace rana ce galibi ake yin bikin suna (naming ceremony) na jariri bayan haihuwa?
questions.explanation: The naming ceremony (bikin suna) is traditionally held on the seventh day after a child's birth in Hausa custom.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira gwanintar sana'ar hannu ta gargajiya ta yin fatauci ko sassaka da ake koyarwa daga tsara zuwa tsara a al'adar Hausa?
questions.explanation: Traditional crafts and trades, passed down through generations, form an important part of Hausa cultural and economic life.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A tsarin mulkin gargajiya na Hausa, menene ake kira babban shugaban gargajiya na wani birni ko yankin sarauta?
questions.explanation: The Sarki (emir) traditionally serves as the paramount traditional ruler over a Hausa emirate or town, at the top of the customary political hierarchy.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira kayan kida na gargajiya wanda ake amfani da shi wajen yabon sarakuna ko jarumai a bukukuwa?
questions.explanation: Traditional drums such as the ganga or tambari are customarily played to accompany praise performances honouring rulers and notable figures.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A al'adar cin abinci ta Hausa, menene sunan abincin da aka fi sani wanda ake yi da hatsi (dawa/gero) ake cinsa da miya?
questions.explanation: Tuwo, a thick paste made from grains such as guinea corn or millet, is a staple Hausa food traditionally eaten with soup (miya).

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira gargajiyar tufa da maza Hausa ke sanyawa a manyan bukukuwa, wadda galibi ke da fadi kuma an yi mata ado da zane?
questions.explanation: The babbar riga is a large, elaborately embroidered traditional gown worn by Hausa men on important ceremonial occasions.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A al'adar Hausa, menene babban muhimmancin gaisuwa (greeting) a hulda ta yau da kullum?
options: Nuna girmamawa da kula da dangantaka a tsakanin mutane
Ana amfani da ita ne kawai a wajen kasuwanci
Ana yin ta ne kawai da baki
questions.explanation: Greetings hold deep cultural importance in Hausa society, expressing respect and maintaining social relationships in daily interactions.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira kasuwar gargajiya da ake gudanarwa a kwana takamaimai, misali kowace rana ta hudu, a garuruwan Hausa?
options: Kantin sayar da kayayyaki na zamani
questions.explanation: Periodic markets, held on a recurring cycle of specific days, are a long-standing feature of traditional Hausa commercial and social life.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A al'adar Hausa, wace muhimmiyar rawa ce dawakai (horses) ke takawa a bukukuwan gargajiya kamar durbar?
options: Ana amfani da su wajen nuna karfi da daukaka a fareruwar sarauta (durbar)
Ana amfani da su ne kawai wajen noma
Ana amfani da su ne kawai domin sufuri na yau da kullum
Ba su da wata alaka da bukukuwan gargajiya
questions.explanation: Horses play a prominent ceremonial role in Hausa culture, especially in the durbar procession, symbolising strength, prestige, and royal tradition.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira hutun bukin da ake yi domin nuna godiya bayan girbin amfanin gona a al'adar Hausa?
questions.explanation: Harvest festivals traditionally celebrate and give thanks for a successful farming season's yield within Hausa agrarian culture.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A al'adar Hausa, menene rawar da 'dattijai' (elders) ke takawa wajen sasanta sabani a cikin al'umma?
options: Suna kula da harkokin kasuwanci ne kawai
Ba su da wata rawa a al'ummar gargajiya
Ana kore su daga tarukan al'umma
Suna taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen shiga tsakani da bayar da shawara domin warware sabani cikin lumana
questions.explanation: Elders traditionally play a central role in Hausa society as mediators and advisors, helping resolve disputes peacefully within the community.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira babbar kasuwar gargajiya da ake yi kowace rana ko mako a garuruwan Hausa domin sayarwa da sayen kaya?
questions.explanation: The traditional market (kasuwa) is a central hub for trade and social interaction in Hausa towns, held daily or on fixed market days.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A al'adar Hausa, menene ake kira sana'ar noma da ke daya daga cikin manyan ayyukan tattalin arziki na al'umma?
questions.explanation: Farming (noma) has traditionally been one of the principal economic activities of the Hausa people.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira kayan kida na gargajiya da ake amfani da shi wajen yin kidan sarauta a fadar Hausa?
questions.explanation: The kakaki is a long ceremonial trumpet traditionally used in royal Hausa court music and processions.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A al'adar Hausa, menene ake kira tufafin gargajiya na maza wanda galibi babban riga ne mai fadi tare da hula?
options: Babban riga da hula (gown and cap)
questions.explanation: Traditional Hausa men's attire typically includes a flowing gown (babban riga) paired with an embroidered cap (hula).

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira gaisuwar gargajiya ta girmamawa da ake yi wa babba a al'adar Hausa, wanda ke nuna biyayya da ladabi?
questions.explanation: Rusuna, a respectful bowing greeting, is a traditional way of showing deference and politeness to elders or superiors in Hausa culture.
